ceo.title: CEO / Business Leader
ceo.summary: Serial founder with 30+ years of category creation — from the first internet software company (1992) to bootstrapped PaaS (2024). Built and scaled products serving millions without external funding.

cto.title: CTO / Technical Founder
cto.summary: Product-minded CTO with a 30-year track record of 0-to-1 innovation. Built the first global mobile internet, scaled social audio infrastructure, and architected a zero-trust PaaS from scratch.

architect.title: Principal Architect
architect.summary: Principal Architect who doesn't just design systems — builds them. From the first global mobile internet to a 150-endpoint distributed mesh.

fullstack.title: Full Stack Engineer
fullstack.summary: Full Stack Engineer who builds from protocol to UX. Node.js/TypeScript, React/Next.js, WASM, WireGuard, DNS, SMTP.

mobile.title: Mobile Engineer
mobile.summary: Mobile engineer who built the first iOS picture-sharing app and wrote SDK integrations for social platforms. Native iOS, React Native, Swift, Kotlin.

infra.title: Infrastructure / SRE Engineer
infra.summary: Infrastructure engineer who writes protocols. Built custom SMTP server, DNS server, WireGuard mesh, ACME automation, and 150+ REST endpoints on bare-metal LXC.

solutions.title: Solutions / Forward Engineer
solutions.summary: Forward Engineer bridging product, architecture, and AI-assisted development. Writes the integration, closes the deal, and handles hyper-growth scaling.

product.title: Product Leader
product.summary: Product leader who codes. Launched the first global mobile internet UX, the first iOS picture-sharing app, and a zero-trust PaaS — all built hands-on from concept to scale.

default.title: Product-Minded Principal Engineer
default.summary: Founding Engineer & Principal Architect with a 30-year track record of 0-to-1 innovation and hyper-scale delivery. Combines product vision with deep engineering — from low-level protocols to end-user UX.
